verse_part: so that you will be mute
and they will bereave you of children;
so that I would be far
Is it too light a thing
in the midst of the city
out of the midst of the city
I had removed them far away
and on those who have plastered
and I will cut him off
that you might play the harlot
and offered them up to idols
you played the harlot with them
and I will bring on you
into the hands of your lovers,
and I will prove Myself holy
And when she had been defiled
because you have played the harlot
concerning her who was worn out
And I will cut you off
then I will bring you down
and I will make you dwell
and you will be no more;
that is a match for you.
Therefore I have cast you as profane
And I will manifest My holiness
And I will bring you up
And I will make them so small
And all that is in it,
and those who were its strength
Yet you will be brought down
And they shall lift you up
yet he will be made to lie down
but in that same iniquity of his
what he has taken by robbery,
so I will make Myself known
and you have been taken up
like the uncleanness of a woman
that you may come to life.
and you will come to life,
and I will turn you around,
and they will take the spoil
the things that are most holy;
that has died a natural death
or has been torn to pieces.
as much as he is able to give,
as much as one is able to give,
